elevation-token.sql: SELECT e.token_hash FROM arena_admin_elevations e JOIN arena_admin_pins p ON p.station_id=e.station_id AND p.version=e.pin_version WHERE e.token_hash=? AND e.station_id=? AND e.station_session_id=? AND e.revoked_at IS NULL AND e.expires_at>? AND e.last_active_at>?

station-wide-revoke.sql: UPDATE arena_admin_elevations SET revoked_at=? WHERE station_id=? AND revoked_at IS NULL
plan: SEARCH arena_admin_elevations USING INDEX arena_admin_elevation_station (station_id=? AND revoked_at=?)

attempt-reservation.sql: SELECT attempts FROM arena_admin_pin_attempts WHERE station_id=?
